description: Pre-optimization repeated fixed segment; MIDI-only 1080x1920 scene, same 300 timestamps (0..299/30) on both runs. Existing project files were not changed.
measurement_notes: screenshot_time includes browser paint, JPEG compression and Playwright transfer; these are not separately observable from the current API.
stdin_write_time includes pipe backpressure from concurrent FFmpeg decoding and encoding; it is not pure encoder CPU time.
ffmpeg_wait_sec is post-input drain and MP4 mux finalization, not the whole overlapping encode time.
The current host reports x86_64 and is not the user's M1 MacBook Air; results are not transferable to that hardware.
